contract: The pool capacity of two bounds physically running operations, not just unresolved client promises. Cancellation is a request; the transport remains running until acknowledgeCancel or complete. Winner delivery need not await loser drainage.

evidenceRequirements.description: Explain how the supplied guard preserves its contract across relevant ownership/time boundaries. Do not require knowledge of an unseen sibling. Evaluator counterfactual only: Two hedges occupy both permits. A winner releases its own permit and requests loser cancellation. Releasing the loser before cancellation acknowledgement permits two replacements while the loser still runs: physical occupancy becomes three against capacity two.

Explain at least one relevant boundary or benign path inferable from the supplied code/context; the following evaluator examples are alternatives, not a mandatory unseen checklist: A loser that completes before the winner must not double-release; acknowledgement restores capacity; a duplicate acknowledgement cannot underflow accounting.

forbiddenClaims: Production outage, real data exfiltration or universal safety without supplied evidence.
A missing contract establishes either a definite defect or unconditional protection.
Simulated time or offline passing tests establish real scheduler/OS behavior or model improvement.
